invalidBaseUrl.zh-CN: Decisions baseUrl 必须是无凭证、查询参数或片段的 HTTPS URL；仅本机测试允许 HTTP。
invalidBaseUrl.en-US: Decisions baseUrl must use HTTPS without credentials, query, or fragment; HTTP is allowed only for loopback tests.

invalidEnvName.zh-CN: Decisions 密钥环境变量名格式不正确。
invalidEnvName.en-US: Invalid Decisions API key environment variable name.

missingToken.zh-CN: 没有找到 Decisions API key；请由可信运行层注入 apiKeyEnv 指定的环境变量。
missingToken.en-US: No Decisions API key found; have the trusted launcher supply the variable named by apiKeyEnv.

invalidModel.zh-CN: Decisions 模型名称不能为空。
invalidModel.en-US: The Decisions model name cannot be empty.

invalidQuestions.zh-CN: Decisions 需要 Noul 或 Choice 问题及说明；Choice 必须有 2–255 个候选。
invalidQuestions.en-US: Decisions requires Noul or Choice questions with instructions; Choice must have 2–255 candidates.

invalidResponse.zh-CN: Decisions 响应不是有效 JSON，或答案数量不正确。
invalidResponse.en-US: The Decisions response is invalid JSON or has an unexpected answer count.

invalidAnswer.zh-CN: Decisions 拒绝回答，或答案名称、类型、概率或候选不合法。
invalidAnswer.en-US: Decisions refused a question or returned invalid answer names, types, probabilities, or candidates.

requestFailed.zh-CN: Decisions 请求失败（HTTP {status}）；未记录服务端正文。
requestFailed.en-US: Decisions request failed (HTTP {status}); the server body was not recorded.

networkFailed.zh-CN: Decisions 请求无法建立连接，重试次数已用尽。
networkFailed.en-US: The Decisions request could not reach the service; retries were exhausted.

responseTooLarge.zh-CN: Decisions 响应超过 1 MiB 上限。
responseTooLarge.en-US: The Decisions response exceeds the 1 MiB limit.

aborted.zh-CN: 上级请求已终止，Decisions 请求已取消。
aborted.en-US: The parent request was aborted, so the Decisions request was cancelled.

timeout.zh-CN: Decisions 审查超时（所有批次与重试共用预算）。
timeout.en-US: Decisions review timed out (all batches and retries share one budget).
